verdict.line: Picture a homeowner who needs internet where wired options are scarce. T‑Mobile’s 5G Home Internet offers unlimited data, no contract, and simple setup, making it a good choice for light to moderate use. The main catch is that speeds are slower than cable or fiber and can vary throughout the day.
